description: A Telegram TUI client for the terminal, with folders, media previews, reactions, and compose suggestions.
notes: First launch opens an onboarding wizard for the Telegram API ID/hash and login. Create credentials at https://my.telegram.org/apps.

ffmpeg is optional and detected in PATH at runtime -- there is nothing to configure. Without it, GIF, MP4 and WebM messages fall back to a text label such as '[GIF] 3s (cached; press O to open)' instead of a picture, and inline animation never starts even if you enable it. Photos and stickers decode in pure Go and are unaffected.
Inline GIF/MP4/WebM animation is off by default; turn it on in Settings (? -> General).
